faces.name: Grasping Shadows
faces.text: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, it gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. Put a dread counter on this enchantment. Then if there are three or more dread counters on it, transform it.

faces.name: Shadows' Lair
faces.text:
(Transforms from Grasping Shadows.)
{T}: Add {B}.
{B}, {T}, Remove a dread counter from this land: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
